in_sanskrit.name: Athi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath, Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Athi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, 'Athi' translates to 'breath' or 'life'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to give the breath of life to all beings.

in_tamil.name: Athi
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Breath, Life
in_tamil.long_meaning: Athi ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। In Sanskrit, 'Athi' translates to 'breath' or 'life'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to give the breath of life to all beings.

in_telugu.name: Athi
in_telugu.long_meaning: Athi ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। In Sanskrit, 'Athi' translates to 'breath' or 'life'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to give the breath of life to all beings.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Athi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, 'Athi' translates to 'breath' or 'life'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with Lord Shiva, who is believed to give the breath of life to all beings.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Breath, Life
